job.title: Competitive Intelligence Analysis for Mobile Wound Care
job.description: I need a fast and accurate market assessment to identify the least-penetrated markets for a mobile wound care business. We need to analyze 15 specific MSA markets within 24-48 hours. The ideal candidate will use AI tools and modern digital research methods—not traditional, manual research—to complete this project quickly and cost-effectively.
deliverables: MSA Ranking: A spreadsheet that ranks the 15 MSAs from least to most competitor penetration
Competitor List: For each MSA, a list of the top 3-5 mobile wound care competitors
Data Points: For each competitor, key data points including Website URL, Estimated SEO presence/ranking, Number of online reviews, and Key services offered
tools_suggested: Google Search / AI Search for competitor identification
Ahrefs or Semrush for SEO and keyword rankings
Google Trends to show search interest per MSA
Browse AI or similar scraping tools for competitor data
ChatGPT or similar AI for summarizing findings and identifying patterns

proposal.text:
Hello,

I understand that you need a fast and accurate market assessment to identify the least-penetrated MSAs for your mobile wound care business within the next 24–48 hours. Speed and accuracy are key here, and that’s exactly where I can help.

I specialize in AI-driven market and competitor research, combining digital tools with automation to deliver insights quickly and cost-effectively. For example, I recently completed a mobile sentiment analysis on the Kenyan e-commerce market (Jumia), where I leveraged Python, scraping tools, and natural language processing to extract, analyze, and present actionable insights. I’ve attached that project in my portfolio for you to review.

My Approach for Your Project:

Competitor Identification: Using Google/AI search and scraping tools to pinpoint the top 3–5 mobile wound care providers in each MSA.

SEO & Online Presence Analysis: Leveraging Ahrefs/Semrush to evaluate competitor visibility, rankings, and keyword strength.

Market Demand Check: Using Google Trends to compare search interest across the 15 MSAs.

Competitor Data Extraction: Automating data pulls (Browse AI / Python scripts) to capture services, locations, and online reviews.

AI Summaries: Using ChatGPT for quick pattern recognition and to synthesize competitor data into clear insights.

Deliverables:

MSA Ranking: From least to most competitor penetration.

Competitor Lists: Top 3–5 competitors per MSA.

Key Data Points: SEO presence, reviews, services, and URLs—structured in a clean, easy-to-use spreadsheet.

I can deliver this within your timeframe while ensuring accuracy, automation, and insights that help you make the right market entry decision.

📌 Let’s discuss your 15 target MSAs so I can get started right away. Would you like me to share a sample output structure before we proceed?

Best regards,
Adiel Maina
